title: Retail Management Solutions and NimbleRx Team Up to Bring Digital Convenience to Independent Pharmacies
body_markdown:
**REDWOOD CITY, CA, November 12, 2026** –[NimbleRx](https://www.nimblerx.com/) , a Swoop company, and[Retail Management Solutions](https://www.rm-solutions.com/) (RMS) today announced a partnership that gives RMS pharmacies free access to NimbleRx’s patient engagement and fulfillment platform. The platform helps pharmacy teams save time and earn more revenue from the prescriptions they already fill.


‍


"We're pleased to announce this integration with NimbleRx, furthering our goal to help pharmacy owners improve both profitability and customer-centricity," said Karen Deckard, Director of Sales at RMS. "By implementing NimbleRx's patient engagement tools, pharmacies can easily drive repeat business, expand reach, and improve the patient experience."


‍


RMS helps independent pharmacies maximize success with a full suite of point of sale (POS) solutions that integrate with pharmacy management systems. As patients increasingly expect local pharmacies to offer digital checkout, text updates, and quick refills, NimbleRx adds a patient-facing layer through its mobile app that automates outreach and digital checkout. These tools help independent pharmacies offer that convenience and preserve the personal care their communities value, while helping them grow revenue.


‍


NimbleRx has been shown to improve medication adherence by 26 percent to 40 percent, supporting patient outcomes and the pharmacy’s bottom line.


‍


**What RMS pharmacies get with NimbleRx:**


- **Patient messaging:** Automated refill reminders, ready-for-pickup alerts, and HIPAA-compliant two-way texting that keep patients on therapy without staff chasing them by phone.


- **Patient app and digital checkout:** Patients can request refills, pay, and sign ahead of time, so they can walk in and out of their pharmacy faster.


- **Revenue growth:** NimbleRx increases refills, reduces abandoned prescriptions, helps pharmacies recoup processing fees, and pays pharmacies for most orders completed through the platform.


- **Time back for staff:** Automated workflows take over routine follow-ups, so pharmacists and technicians can spend more time on patient care.


‍


With the integration, pickup orders and tasks are synced so pharmacy teams can keep checkout moving without the need to switch back and forth between systems.


‍


"Independent pharmacies are always looking for practical ways to make the day run more smoothly while giving patients the convenience they expect," said Scott Von Deylen, Head of Pharmacy at Swoop. "With NimbleRx, RMS pharmacies can bring refill outreach, digital checkout, and patient messaging together in one experience, helping teams save time and grow revenue while keeping the personal care patients count on."


‍


To learn more about the partnership, visit[nimblerx.com/nimblerx-demo-rms.](https://www.nimblerx.com/nimblerx-demo-rms)


‍


**About NimbleRx, a Swoop company**


‍


NimbleRx, a Swoop company, improves patient outcomes by helping patients start therapy faster, stay on treatment longer, and remain connected throughout their healthcare journey. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, NimbleRx empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.


‍


NimbleRx simplifies every step of the prescription journey, from prescription onboarding and mobile checkout to refills, adherence support, and patient communications. By reducing administrative burden and improving patient engagement, NimbleRx enables pharmacists to spend more time focused on patient care. The platform has been shown to improve medication adherence by 26 percent to 40 percent, helping pharmacies, life sciences companies, and healthcare providers drive better health outcomes at scale.


‍


**About RMS**


‍


Retail Management Solutions is an industry leader in pharmacy point-of-sale (POS) technology, dedicated to helping independent and outpatient pharmacies thrive. Since 1998, RMS has provided innovative, pharmacy-focused solutions that streamline operations, improve patient care, and drive profitability. To learn more about RMS, click[here](https://www.rm-solutions.com/about) .
